values.binNote: The bin has no data value for the inter-bounce delay; the wiki-stated 0.15s is not represented in the sheet's BrandR rows.

mechanics.claim: The fireball bounces between nearby enemies and Brand up to four times, dealing damage each time.
mechanics.quote: launches a fireball at the target enemy that bounces between nearby enemies and '''Brand''' up to four times, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies each time

mechanics.claim: Pyroclasm prioritizes Ablaze enemy champions for bounce targeting, then other enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: ''Pyroclasm'' prioritizes ''{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}}'' enemy champions, then other enemy champions, then any valid bounce target, then '''Brand'''.

mechanics.claim: An Ablaze target hit by the bounce is also briefly slowed.
mechanics.quote: An ''Ablaze'' target will also be briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}} when hit.

mechanics.claim: The same enemy can be hit and slowed by the missile more than once (multiple bounces).
mechanics.quote: This can affect the same enemy more than once.

mechanics.claim: If the bounce is blocked by an enemy's spell shield it deals no damage but keeps bouncing; if the initial target has a spell shield the ability does not bounce at all.
mechanics.quote: If the initial cast target uses {{tip|spell shield}}, ''Pyroclasm'' will not bounce. If the bounce is blocked by an enemy's ''spell shield'' it will not deal any damage, but it will keep on bouncing.

mechanics.claim: The fireball still bounces off a target even if that target is dead upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: The fireball will still bounce from the target even if they were dead upon arrival.
